title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
title_zh: 预训练知道做什么，模拟教会怎么做：模拟训练的机器人智能体的组合泛化

paragraphs.en: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3 × \times faster and 17 × \times cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don’t appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人策略需要理解任务在场景中的要求，以及如何移动机器人来完成该任务。 为了实现这两项能力，我们提出零真机智能体策略（Zero-real Agent Policy, ZAP），这是一种通过简单的工具框架教会小型现成视觉语言模型控制机器人的方法。 我们使用预训练的 27B 参数模型来引导对世界的理解与推理，随后在简单的仿真任务上进行监督微调和 GRPO，教会它如何移动机器人。 在训练期间不使用任何真实世界机器人数据的情况下，ZAP 在真实世界任务上达到 96.7% 的成功率，在我们的框架中与 GPT-6 Astra 持平，并优于 MolmoAct2 VLA（33.3%），同时运行速度比 GPT-6 Astra 快 3 × \times 倍，成本低 17 × \times 倍。 我们证明 ZAP 还能泛化到全新的物体、目标、策略和语言：将试管放入试管架（并在提示下选择架上的不同孔位）、在空中于两臂之间传递试管、在井字棋盘上画 X，以及下国际象棋。 这些目标和操作类型并未出现在我们的训练数据中。 此外，ZAP 还能迁移到未见过的机器人本体上。 在单臂 Franka 上，ZAP 在 RoboLab-120 上达到 55.9%，领先当前最强的 VLA/WAM 基线 4.9 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: A robot policy has to do two difficult things at once: it needs semantic reasoning to understand instructions in a potentially unfamiliar scene, and motion control to translate that understanding into precise physical actions.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人策略必须同时完成两件困难的事情：它需要语义推理来理解潜在陌生场景中的指令，还需要运动控制将这种理解转化为精确的物理动作。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), which adds motion to a small pretrained vision-language model through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), entirely in simulation. We evaluate how these skills carry over to new tasks, real hardware, and a new embodiment. Existing methods tend to trade off performance in one of these areas for the others, and broadly fall into three groups (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出零真智能体策略（ZAP），通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL），完全在仿真中为一个小型预训练视觉-语言模型赋予运动能力。 我们评估这些技能如何迁移到新任务、真实硬件以及新的具身形态上。 现有方法往往在某些方面以牺牲其他方面的性能为代价，大致可分为三类（表 1）。

sents.en: We introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), which adds motion to a small pretrained vision-language model through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), entirely in simulation.
sents.zh: 我们提出零真智能体策略（ZAP），通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL），完全在仿真中为一个小型预训练视觉-语言模型赋予运动能力。

sents.en: We evaluate how these skills carry over to new tasks, real hardware, and a new embodiment.
sents.zh: 我们评估这些技能如何迁移到新任务、真实硬件以及新的具身形态上。

sents.en: Existing methods tend to trade off performance in one of these areas for the others, and broadly fall into three groups (Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 现有方法往往在某些方面以牺牲其他方面的性能为代价，大致可分为三类（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: Models that directly output robot actions. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs) learn semantic reasoning & motion control from robot action data [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Because diverse action data is scarce, both skills end up tied to the training distribution: the policy often generalizes poorly to new prompts, objects, scenes and goals, and a new task usually means training again.
paragraphs.zh: 直接输出机器人动作的模型。 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）从机器人动作数据中学习语义推理与运动控制 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 由于多样化的动作数据稀缺，这两种能力最终都与训练分布绑定：策略在应对新的提示词、物体、场景和目标时往往泛化能力较差，而一个新任务通常意味着需要重新训练。

sents.zh: 直接输出机器人动作的模型。

paragraphs.en: Code that directly drives the robot. In Code as Policies [ 5 , 6 ] , a language model writes a program that composes perception and control APIs. This is quick and reliable when the situations it will face can be anticipated when the program is written, but struggles outside that script, for example with an unexpected failure, an unfamiliar object or an ambiguous instruction. Adapting to a new task or scene means rewriting the program.
paragraphs.zh: 直接驱动机器人的代码。 在 Code as Policies [ 5 , 6 ] 中，语言模型编写一个组合感知与控制 API 的程序。 当程序编写时就能预见它将面对的情境时，这种方式快速且可靠，但在该脚本之外就会陷入困境，例如遇到意外的故障、不熟悉的物体或模糊的指令。 适应新任务或新场景意味着重写程序。

paragraphs.en: Large frontier models controlling the robot through tools. Frontier language models interacting with the robot via an agentic harness bring world understanding, reasoning and generalization [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . But they are not explicitly trained to move a robot, and a trillion-parameter model is slow and costs dollars for a task that smaller policy models, when they can do them, do in seconds and cost pennies.
paragraphs.zh: 大型前沿模型通过工具控制机器人。 前沿语言模型通过智能体框架与机器人交互，带来对世界的理解、推理和泛化能力 [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。 但它们并没有被显式地训练来驱动机器人，而且一个万亿参数的模型既缓慢又昂贵——一个任务，较小的策略模型如果能够完成，只需几秒钟、成本仅几美分，而它却要花费数美元。

sents.en: Large frontier models controlling the robot through tools.
sents.zh: 大型前沿模型通过工具控制机器人。

paragraphs.en: ZAP combines semantic reasoning from vision-language pretraining with motion control learned entirely in simulation. We start with Qwen 3.6 27B [ 10 ] , which contributes world understanding and reasoning. We then teach the model motion control in simulation - first SFT on its own mined successful traces, followed by RL across 40 pick-and-place, stacking, and reorientation tasks. Neither stage uses real-world robot demonstrations. At test time, the policy combines pretrained semantic reasoning with learned motion control to perform real-world tasks it was never trained to execute, generalizing to new objects, goals, and robot embodiments.
paragraphs.zh: ZAP 将来自视觉-语言预训练的语义推理与完全在仿真中学习的运动控制相结合。 我们从 Qwen 3.6 27B [ 10 ] 开始，它提供了对世界的理解与推理能力。 随后我们在仿真中教该模型运动控制——先在其自身挖掘的成功轨迹上进行 SFT，再在 40 个抓取放置、堆叠和重定向任务上进行 RL 训练。 两个阶段都不使用真实世界的机器人示范。 在测试时，该策略将预训练的语义推理与学到的运动控制相结合，执行从未训练过的真实世界任务，并能泛化到新的物体、目标和机器人本体。

paragraphs.en: Teacher-free training of an agent policy in simulation. We teach a pretrained vision-language model to control a robot with no frontier teacher and no real robot data. The model commands end-effector poses and gripper openings through a harness that is identical in simulation and on hardware. We seed it with successful traces mined from its own rollouts, then refine it with RL using a dense reward ladder that credits partial progress (§ 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在仿真中实现无教师训练的智能体策略。 我们在没有前沿教师、没有真实机器人数据的条件下，教会一个预训练视觉-语言模型控制机器人。 该模型通过一个在仿真和硬件上完全相同的框架，下达末端执行器位姿与夹爪开合的指令。 我们先用从其自身轨迹中挖掘出的成功片段对其进行冷启动，然后用强化学习结合一个奖励部分进展的稠密奖励阶梯对其进行精调（§ 3 ）。

paragraphs.en: Composing reasoning and motion. Task-and-motion planners compose symbolic operators that ground into geometric motion [ 11 , 12 ] . Large language models then proved to be better high-level planners, sequencing a library of learned skills [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] or handing subgoals to low-level policies [ 16 , 17 ] . ZAP keeps the split between reasoning and motion but drops the fixed skill library. Motion is a skill the model learns itself, through a minimal harness that leaves scene reasoning and action sequencing to the model rather than imposing macros that simplify familiar tasks but limit generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 将推理与运动组合起来。 任务与运动规划器组合符号算子，再将其落地为几何运动 [ 11 , 12 ] 。 大语言模型随后被证明是更好的高层规划器，能够对学习到的技能库进行排序 [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] ，或将子目标交给低层策略 [ 16 , 17 ] 。 ZAP 保留了推理与运动的分工，但去掉了固定的技能库。 运动是模型自己学习的一项技能，借助一个最小化的框架，将场景推理与动作排序留给模型，而不是强加那些能简化熟悉任务但限制泛化能力的宏。

paragraphs.en: End-to-end policies. VLAs and WAMs fold reasoning and motion into one network trained on robot actions [ 1 , 3 , 18 , 4 ] . Several studies show that these policies keep the intent of an instruction but fail to execute it on new tasks, perturbations or skill combinations [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] . ZAP instead inherits the reasoning and language ability of a pretrained LLM and learns only motion, in simulation. It never has to learn language from action data, so it is not tied to the instructions that data happens to contain, and it follows what an instruction means rather than how it is worded.

paragraphs.en: Foundation models as robot agents. Code as Policies and its successors compose perception and control APIs into programs [ 5 , 23 ] , and frontier agents now act directly as closed-loop policies through tool harnesses [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . It commands complete end-effector poses rather than grasp macros. Guava’s unseen tasks recombine the grasp, place and push primitives it was trained on; ZAP composes motions it never practiced, such as a mid-air handoff and a marker stroke, and runs on a different robot without retraining.

paragraphs.en: We first describe the harness, the tool interface through which the model perceives and acts, identical in simulation and on hardware (§ 3.1 ). We then describe how we train the model to move entirely in simulation using GRPO and a dense reward ladder (§ 3.2 ), and how we initialize that run from successful traces gathered by a short GRPO warm-up and prefix-tree search (§ 3.3 ).

paragraphs.en: ZAP controls two 6-DoF (degrees-of-freedom) YAM arms with parallel-jaw grippers [ 26 ] . It commands absolute end-effector poses and gripper openings, rather than joint angles, trajectories, or action chunks. We frame tasks as a conversation between the model and its environment through the harness: the model first writes a plan and names the objects to locate based on camera views of the environment, then repeatedly issues perception and movement tool calls to complete its task.

paragraphs.en: The harness uses SAM 3.1 [ 27 , 28 ] to segment the objects named in the model’s perception queries in each camera stream. These masks are combined with calibrated depth cameras to yield each object’s 3D centroid, height, and principal axes. This process runs continuously and asynchronously in the background: the model steers perception by changing its queries, and receives object measurements and annotated camera images.

paragraphs.en: We build our simulated tasks in Isaac Sim [ 29 ] by adding simulated YAM arms with calibrated cameras and arm dynamics against real YAM arms.

paragraphs.en: Learning motion control on simulated tasks. We design 40 simulated tasks, none of which appear in RoboLab-120, that exercise the same families of everyday object manipulation skills: grasping and lifting, single- and multi-object pick and place, stacking, and reorientation. The goals are deliberately simple, and none requires heavy reasoning. This lets us test whether motion control learned on simple tasks can combine with pretrained semantic reasoning to solve unseen tasks with new goals and strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 在模拟任务上学习运动控制。 我们设计了40个模拟任务，这些任务均未出现在 RoboLab-120 中，它们锻炼同几类日常物体操作技能：抓取与抬起、单物体与多物体拾取和放置、堆叠以及重新定向。 这些目标刻意保持简单，且没有一个需要繁重的推理。 这让我们能够测试：在简单任务上学到的运动控制，能否与预训练的语义推理相结合，以解决具有新目标和新策略的未见任务。

paragraphs.en: GRPO with dense rewards. The GRPO run is initialized from the checkpoint detailed in § 3.3 and trains on all 40 tasks (hyperparameters in Appendix C ). Binary reward based on task success is inefficient since some tasks start with zero successes, and therefore a pass/fail reward would provide zero advantage and contribute no gradient. We instead shape a dense ladder of partial credit judged on the final state of the scene, manually designed per task type.
paragraphs.zh: 使用密集奖励的GRPO。 GRPO运行从§ 3.3中详述的检查点初始化，并在全部40个任务上训练（超参数见附录C）。 基于任务成功的二元奖励效率低下，因为有些任务最初成功次数为零，因此通过/失败式的奖励会产生零优势，不贡献任何梯度。 我们转而构建一条密集的部分得分阶梯，基于场景的最终状态进行评判，并针对每种任务类型手动设计。

paragraphs.en: For example, for pick and place tasks, approaching the object earns up to 0.2 in proportion to the gripper fingertip-to-object distance closed; grasping earns 0.2 and lifting up to a further 0.55, in proportion to height up to 8 cm. Transport raises the total to at most 0.9, in proportion to the distance to the goal closed. Completing a task earns 5.0, minus a small length penalty which penalizes the model for taking too many turns to complete the task. The specific numbers for partial credit were not ablated and instead holistically chosen: our guiding principle was that final task success must have a much higher reward than partial reward; otherwise, the model settles for collecting partial credit. The success checker is hardened against reward hacking, for example, by requiring that the goal hold for at least half a second.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，在抓取与放置任务中，接近物体按夹爪指尖到物体距离的缩短比例最多可获得 0.2；完成抓取获得 0.2，抬升按高度（最高 8 厘米）比例最多再获得 0.55。 运输按到目标点距离的缩短比例将总分提升至最多 0.9。 完成任务获得 5.0，并减去一个小的长度惩罚，用于惩罚模型花费过多回合才完成任务。 部分得分的具体数值并未做消融实验，而是整体上人为选定的：我们的指导原则是，最终任务成功必须获得远高于部分得分的奖励；否则，模型会满足于只收集部分得分。 成功判定器针对奖励投机做了加固，例如要求目标状态至少持续保持半秒钟。

paragraphs.en: We penalize turns where either no tool call is made, or where invalid motion is proposed and doesn’t pass certain validation checks (see Appendix A ). paragraphs.en: Seeding the model with its own successes. A model which is on-distribution for its task space helps reduce variance during RL training, so we first fine-tune on successful agent traces. That raises the question of how to collect them. One option is rejection sampling from either our fixed base model or a larger open model. However, this is prohibitively inefficient, and many tasks never succeed even after hundreds of attempts per task. Instead, initializing from the base model, we run a short GRPO warm-up run of several dozen steps and over-sample the harder tasks, and mine its successful rollouts for SFT. As the policy improves, harder tasks start to yield successes, so the data comes from a slightly evolved version of the model itself, a self-distillation loop that is close to on-policy.
paragraphs.zh: 用模型自身的成功案例作为种子数据。 在任务空间上处于分布内的模型有助于降低 RL 训练中的方差，因此我们首先在成功的智能体轨迹上进行微调。 这就引出了一个问题：如何收集这些轨迹。 一种选择是从固定的基础模型或更大的开源模型中进行拒绝采样。 然而，这种做法效率极低，而且许多任务即使每个尝试数百次也从未成功。 作为替代，我们从基础模型初始化，先运行一个仅有几十步的短 GRPO 预热训练，并对较难的任务进行过采样，然后从中挖掘成功的 rollout 用于 SFT。 随着策略不断改进，更难的任务也开始产生成功案例，因此数据来自模型自身略微进化后的版本——一个接近同策略的自蒸馏循环。

paragraphs.en: Prefix-tree search. For tasks that still never succeed, we perform a tree-search over partial episodes (Appendix Figure 8 ). A node is created after each physical action settles; to expand it, we reset the simulator to the task’s deterministic start, replay the node’s stored actions, restore the agent’s context, and sample a new continuation. A best-first rule favors high dense reward and less-explored nodes and prunes failing branches, with up to about 1,000 leaves per task. This found successful traces for several tasks that RL sampling never solved, and these traces are added to the fine-tuning data.
paragraphs.zh: 前缀树搜索。 对于仍然从未成功的任务，我们在部分回合上执行树搜索（附录图 8）。 每个物理动作结束后创建一个节点；为了扩展该节点，我们将模拟器重置为任务的确定性起点，重放该节点存储的动作，恢复智能体的上下文，并采样一个新的延续。 一种最佳优先规则倾向于高密集奖励和探索较少的节点，并剪除失败的分支，每个任务最多约 1,000 个叶节点。 这为若干强化学习采样从未解决的任务找到了成功轨迹，并且这些轨迹被加入微调数据中。

paragraphs.en: Note that, with the same harness, the base Qwen model fails on almost every task. Looking at its thinking, it clearly understands the scene and goal. What it lacks is the ability to properly move the robot. It fails to choose the right grasp orientation and height, approach the object correctly and translate 3D perception into motion commands. Training with SFT and RL adds this missing motion control skill.

paragraphs.en: Setup. We recreate 10 tasks of diverse complexity from the RoboLab-120 task list on the real robot (Appendix D lists each task prompt and each model’s success rate). We ran 3 trials per task on a bimanual rig with two YAM arms and the same three-camera layout as in simulation. We compare against GPT-6 Astra [ 31 ] (reasoning level max) in our harness, GPT-6 Astra in the Robocurve Inspect Robots harness [ 8 , 32 ] , MolmoAct2 [ 4 ] , a public VLA for bimanual YAM arms, and the base Qwen 3.6 27B we started from.
paragraphs.zh: 环境搭建。 我们在真实机器人上从 RoboLab-120 任务列表中复现了 10 个复杂度各异的任务（附录 D 列出了每个任务的提示词以及每个模型的成功率）。 我们在一个配备双 YAM 机械臂、且与仿真中相同的三相机布局的双臂平台上，对每个任务各进行了 3 次试验。 我们对比的对象包括：在我们的测试框架中运行的 GPT-6 Astra [ 31 ]（推理级别设为 max）、在 Robocurve Inspect Robots 测试框架 [ 8 , 32 ] 中运行的 GPT-6 Astra、面向双臂 YAM 机械臂的开源 VLA 模型 MolmoAct2 [ 4 ]，以及我们最初基于的 Qwen 3.6 27B 基础模型。

sents.zh: 环境搭建。

sents.en: We recreate 10 tasks of diverse complexity from the RoboLab-120 task list on the real robot (Appendix D lists each task prompt and each model’s success rate).

paragraphs.en: Parity with GPT-6 Astra. ZAP matches GPT-6 Astra in the same harness (Table 3 ), and both clearly outperform GPT-6 Astra in the Robocurve harness, MolmoAct2, and the base model. The base model, with the same reasoning and harness but no motion training, succeeds on 16.7%.

paragraphs.en: Where the VLA breaks. MolmoAct2’s failures follow the meaning of the instruction more than the difficulty of the motion (Appendix Table 6 ). For example, we evaluate the model’s ability to pick & place a Rubik’s cube in different locations. When asked to place in a bowl, it places it successfully 3/3 times. But when prompted to place the cube behind the bowl, it never succeeds (0/3), often still placing it into the bowl. In another task, the VLA must place exactly 3 bananas in a bin and always places too many. The motions are nearly the same; what changes is a spatial relation or count, reflected in the prompt. A VLA can only learn what words like behind or exactly three mean from its robot action data, whereas ZAP already understands them from vision-language pretraining.
paragraphs.zh: VLA 在哪里失效。 MolmoAct2 的失败更多与指令的含义相关，而非动作的难度（附录表 6）。 例如，我们评估了模型在不同位置抓取并放置魔方的能力。 当被要求把它放进碗里时，它 3/3 次都成功放置。 但当提示它把魔方放到碗后面时，它从未成功（0/3），往往仍然把它放进碗里。 在另一个任务中，该 VLA 必须在箱子里准确放入 3 根香蕉，但总是放得太多。 这些动作几乎相同；变化的只是空间关系或数量，而它们体现在提示词中。 VLA 只能从其机器人动作数据中学习 behind 或 exactly three 这类词的含义，而 ZAP 已经通过视觉-语言预训练理解了这些含义。

paragraphs.en: Generalization to a new robot embodiment comes for free. We take the same checkpoint, trained only on bimanual YAM arms, and evaluate it on a single-arm Franka. From the agent’s perspective, only the system prompt describing the embodiment changes; the harness stays exactly the same. The Franka differs from the YAM in most of the ways that matter to a policy that outputs joint angles or action chunks: one arm instead of two, seven joints instead of six, a different gripper, different reach, and different cameras. ZAP is unaffected by these differences: it commands end-effector poses through the harness, which handles the embodiment-specific joint control.
paragraphs.zh: 泛化到新的机器人本体是免费获得的。 我们采用同一个仅在双臂 YAM 机械臂上训练过的检查点，并在单臂 Franka 上进行评估。 从智能体的视角来看，只有描述本体的系统提示词发生了变化；运行框架保持完全一致。 对于输出关节角度或动作块的策略而言，Franka 在大多数关键方面都与 YAM 不同：一条机械臂而非两条，七个关节而非六个，不同的夹爪，不同的可达范围，以及不同的相机。 ZAP 不受这些差异的影响：它通过运行框架下达末端执行器位姿指令，由框架处理特定本体的关节控制。

sents.en: ZAP is unaffected by these differences: it commands end-effector poses through the harness, which handles the embodiment-specific joint control.
sents.zh: ZAP 不受这些差异的影响：它通过运行框架下达末端执行器位姿指令，由框架处理特定本体的关节控制。

paragraphs.en: Better SFT data improves generalization. paragraphs.en: We next test the model, trained exclusively in simulation, on real-world tasks far outside anything seen in training, from bimanual handoffs to drawing and chess, each requiring reasoning and motion the model never practiced (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将在完全仅通过仿真训练的模型上，测试其在远超训练所见范围的真实世界任务中的表现，包括双手传递物体、绘画和国际象棋等，每一项任务都需要模型从未练习过的推理与运动能力（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: New tasks and objects: the policy should handle objects, scenes, and goals that appear nowhere in training, and construct a physical strategy for them without demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 新任务与新物体：策略应能处理训练中从未出现过的物体、场景与目标，并在无示范的情况下为其构建物理策略。

paragraphs.en: New strategies on request: it should be possible to prompt the policy into manipulations it never practiced, such as coordinating two arms.
paragraphs.zh: 根据请求的新策略：应当能够通过提示（prompt）让策略执行它从未练习过的操作，例如协调两只机械臂。

paragraphs.en: Complex reasoning: the policy should be able to carry over the reasoning capabilities the pretrained LLM has into physical world actions.
paragraphs.zh: 复杂推理：策略应能将预训练大语言模型所具备的推理能力迁移到物理世界的动作中。

paragraphs.en: Language and instruction following: VLAs are notoriously sensitive to their prompts—slight deviations that do not change the meaning can significantly change the policy success rate [ 35 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 语言与指令遵循：VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）对其提示词极为敏感——不改变含义的轻微偏差也可能显著改变策略的成功率 [ 35 ] 。

paragraphs.en: None of the goals, objects, or scenes below appear in training, and neither do any of the more complex prompts, strategies, or reasoning they require.
paragraphs.zh: 以下目标、物体或场景均未出现在训练中，它们所需的更复杂的提示、策略或推理也同样未出现在训练中。

paragraphs.en: A new object and a new task: the test tube. We ask the model to vertically lower a test tube into a rack (Figure 3 ). Both objects and the goal are unseen in training. The model constructs the strategy itself: it grasps the tube lying on its side, turns the gripper so the tube is vertical, and lowers it into a hole. This is challenging because, at the moment of placement, the hole is hidden from every camera. A VLA would typically need task-specific demonstrations of each of these steps; ZAP receives only a single text instruction and, without demonstrations or parameter updates, infers the required motion.
paragraphs.zh: 一个新物体和一项新任务：试管。 我们要求模型将一支试管竖直下放到试管架中（图 3）。 两个物体和目标在训练中都未出现过。 该模型自行构建了策略：它抓住侧放的试管，旋转夹爪使试管竖直，然后将其下放到孔中。 这项任务具有挑战性，因为在放置的那一刻，每个摄像头都看不到孔。 VLA 通常需要针对每个步骤的任务特定演示；而 ZAP 只接收一条文本指令，在没有演示或参数更新的情况下推断出所需的动作。

paragraphs.en: A new strategy on request: bimanual handoff. We then ask for a completely different way to reach the same goal: hand the tube from one arm to the other in mid-air, then place it in the rack (Figure 5 ). The prompt describes the handoff in writing, but training contains no bimanual interaction even close to a handoff. The model orients the tube-cap up and brings it, held by one arm, to the middle of the table; brings the other arm over the tube and descends from above, just far enough to grasp the cap but not so low that it hits the first arm; closes the receiving gripper, then opens the giving one; moves the giving arm out of the way; and lowers the tube into a hole. Getting this right means timing the two grippers against each other: if the giving arm lets go too early the tube falls, and if the receiving arm comes in too low the grippers collide.
paragraphs.zh: 应要求提供一种新策略：双手交接。 接着我们要求用一种完全不同的方式达到同一目标：在半空中把管子从一只手臂递到另一只手臂，然后放入架子（图 5）。 提示词用文字描述了这次交接，但训练数据中完全不包含任何接近交接的双臂交互。 模型将管子调整到管帽朝上，用一只手臂握住并将其移动到桌子中间；将另一只手臂移到管子上方并从上方下降，下降到刚好能抓住管帽的高度，但不会低到碰到第一只手臂；闭合接收侧的夹爪，然后张开递出侧的夹爪；将递出手臂移开；再将管子放入孔中。 要做好这一点需要让两个夹爪的动作彼此精准配合：如果递出手臂松开得太早，管子会掉落；如果接收手臂进入得太低，两个夹爪会相撞。

paragraphs.en: Complex reasoning: tic-tac-toe and chess. The last two tasks require the model to reason about what a goal means before it can act (Figure 6 ). For tic-tac-toe, we prompt the model to draw an X in the center of a tic tac toe game drawn on a whiteboard. It picks up the marker, recognizes what a tic-tac-toe board is and where its center square lies, and draws the X: it keeps enough contact to leave a line through each stroke, without pressing so hard that it breaks or dislodges the marker. The instruction determines both a place on the board and the motion needed to draw there.

paragraphs.en: A robot policy does not need to learn reasoning and motion together from scarce robot data. A 27B VLM brings world understanding and reasoning from pretraining, and SFT followed by RL on 40 simple simulated tasks adds the skill of moving a bimanual robot. A checkpoint trained exclusively in simulation reaches 96.7% success on real hardware tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness while running 3 × \times faster and 17 × \times cheaper, and transfers to a single-arm Franka. Its skills also compose on new real tasks, objects, language and goals: seating a test tube, choosing a different hole when asked, performing a mid-air handoff, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing a checkmate. Because the motion skill comes entirely from simulation, extending it calls for more simulated tasks rather than more robot demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人策略不必从稀缺的机器人数据中同时学习推理与运动。 一个 27B 的视觉语言模型（VLM）通过预训练带来世界理解与推理能力，随后在 40 个简单仿真任务上进行 SFT 和 RL，增加了操作双臂机器人的技能。 一个完全在仿真中训练的检查点在真实硬件任务上达到 96.7% 的成功率，在我们的评测框架中与 GPT-6 Astra 相当，同时速度快 3 × \times 倍、成本低 17 × \times 倍，并且可迁移到单臂 Franka 上。 其技能还能在新的真实任务、物体、语言和目标上进行组合：放置试管、在被要求时选择不同的孔、完成空中交接、在井字棋盘上画 X，以及下出将杀一步。 由于运动技能完全来自仿真，扩展它需要的是更多仿真任务，而不是更多机器人示范。

paragraphs.en: Tools. ZAP has five tools. move_to moves one or both arms to a complete end-effector pose; naming both arms in one call produces a single synchronized motion. set_gripper sets each jaw opening, from 0 (closed) to 1 (fully open). change_query sets the text descriptions of the objects that perception segments. update_todo writes a short plan that is repeated in every later observation, so it survives when old turns are dropped from context. done ends the episode.

paragraphs.en: Poses. Each move_to gives an absolute position of the tool center point, in meters, and a full orientation, in a world frame shared by both arms. paragraphs.en: Orientation. Orientation is given by three angles, each measured counterclockwise from world + x +x (Figure 7 ). Slot yaw ψ \psi is the heading of the jaw slot, the axis a held object lies along. Tilt τ \tau is the angle of the tool axis from straight down: 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} is top-down and 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} is horizontal. Tilt direction ϕ \phi is the compass direction the fingertips point toward. We use these instead of Euler angles or quaternions for two reasons. Neither of those states directly where the gripper points or how its jaws are aligned, the two quantities that decide a grasp. And a horizontal tool, as in a side grasp, lies at an Euler singularity, where a few degrees of physical error can show up as a change of about 100 ∘ 100^{\circ} in the reported angles. Our angles are ambiguous only when the tool points straight down or straight up, where tilt direction has no physical meaning.

paragraphs.en: Observations and perception. Each turn adds one observation to the conversation: one downscaled RGB image from each of the three cameras (for bimanual YAM, overhead and one per wrist), the perception results, the measured tool pose and jaw opening of each arm, and the remaining step budget. Perception uses SAM 3.1 [ 27 , 28 ] , which runs continuously in the background on every camera stream rather than as a tool the model calls and waits on. It segments the objects named by the current queries, draws their masks and numbered boxes on the images, and uses depth to compute each object’s 3D centroid, height and principal axes in world coordinates. The model controls perception only through change_query , which it can call at any time, for example to find a missed object or to segment part of one, such as the cap of a tube. Detections are not fused across cameras; the model decides which ones refer to the same object. In simulation, perception runs on the rendered images and depth, as it does on the real cameras, and never reads any privileged information such as object poses that would be unavailable on hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 观测与感知。 每一回合都会向对话中添加一个观测：来自三台相机（对于双臂 YAM，为顶部相机和每只手腕各一台）的各一张降分辨率 RGB 图像、感知结果、每条机械臂测得的工具位姿与夹爪开度，以及剩余的步数预算。 感知使用 SAM 3.1 [27, 28]，它在后台对每一路相机视频流持续运行，而不是作为模型调用后需要等待的工具。 它会分割当前查询所指定的物体，在图像上绘制它们的掩码和带编号的边框，并利用深度计算每个物体在世界坐标系下的三维质心、高度和主轴。 模型只能通过 change_query 来控制感知，它可以随时调用该操作，例如查找漏检的物体，或分割某个物体的一部分，例如管子的盖子。 各相机的检测结果不做融合；由模型判断哪些结果指向同一个物体。 在仿真中，感知像在真实相机上一样，基于渲染出的图像和深度运行，绝不读取任何在硬件上无法获得的特权信息，例如物体位姿。

paragraphs.en: Controller and outcome reports. The controller turns a valid pose into a straight-line Cartesian path, solves inverse kinematics densely along it, and refuses the motion if the resulting joint path cannot be validated. When the arm comes to rest, the controller reports one of five outcomes per arm: reached (execution completed and the arm came to rest within tolerance), short (the arm came to rest outside tolerance), incomplete (execution began but did not finish, for example because of a stall), not attempted (nothing moved, for example because no valid path exists) or unknown (the outcome could not be determined). Any outcome other than reached also reports its cause, whether it arose in planning or execution, and the measured position and orientation errors.

paragraphs.en: One harness for simulation and hardware. The harness is the same in simulation and on the real robot. Everything specific to a robot, such as joint limits, cameras and workspace bounds, comes from a declarative embodiment description. Moving from the simulator to the real rig, or to the Franka, means swapping that description and the low-level backend, and nothing else. This is why a policy trained only in simulation runs on the real robot without changes.

paragraphs.en: To make the agent loop of § 3.1 concrete, we step through one complete episode of ZAP on the real bimanual rig. The task is “pick up both blocks”. The episode succeeds in 9 turns and 74.6 s of wall-clock time, with 4 robot actions, 118,985 input tokens and 1,920 output tokens. Each image is the observation the agent received at the start of that turn (left wrist, overhead, right wrist); from turn 2 on it includes the SAM 3.1 masks and numbered boxes for the current perception queries, computed in the background. The overhead camera faces the arms from across the table, so its image-left is the robot’s right. paragraphs.en: Compositional reasoning in robotics. Classical robotics composes behavior explicitly. Task-and-motion planners search over symbolic operators that ground into geometric motion [ 11 , 41 , 12 ] . Learned variants acquire the operators, their abstractions or their programs from data [ 42 , 43 , 44 , 45 ] , or chain learned skills with generative models [ 46 ] , or compose diffusion policies across tasks and domains [ 47 ] . Coding agents can also synthesize generalized TAMP programs [ 48 ] . Language models later took over the high-level planner: they plan zero-shot in language or as programs [ 49 , 50 ] , sequence a library of learned skills [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] , hand subgoals to RL-trained or local low-level policies [ 16 , 17 ] , or supply open-world constraints to a TAMP solver [ 51 , 52 ] . ZAP keeps the split between reasoning and motion but drops the fixed skill library. The interface is a set of tools in physical units, and motion is a skill the model learns itself, so a grasp learned on pick and place can be reused as a tube rotation or a marker stroke.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人学中的组合推理。 经典机器人学显式地组合行为。 任务与运动规划器在符号算子空间中搜索，这些算子落地为几何运动 [ 11 , 41 , 12 ] 。 学习型变体从数据中获取算子、其抽象或其程序 [ 42 , 43 , 44 , 45 ] ，或将已学习技能与生成模型链接 [ 46 ] ，或跨任务与领域组合扩散策略 [ 47 ] 。 编程智能体也能合成泛化的 TAMP 程序 [ 48 ] 。 语言模型随后接管了高层规划器：它们以语言或程序的形式零样本规划 [ 49 , 50 ] ，对已学习技能库进行排序 [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] ，将子目标交给强化学习训练的或局部低层策略 [ 16 , 17 ] ，或为 TAMP 求解器提供开放世界约束 [ 51 , 52 ] 。 ZAP 保留了推理与运动之间的分工，但舍弃了固定的技能库。 其接口是一组以物理单位表示的工具，而运动本身是模型自行学习的技能，因此在抓取与放置中学到的抓取可以复用于管子旋转或记号笔笔画。

sents.zh: ZAP 保留了推理与运动之间的分工，但舍弃了固定的技能库。

paragraphs.en: End-to-end policies and their compositional limits. Embodied multimodal language models [ 53 ] and vision-language-action models (VLAs) fold reasoning and motion into one network trained on robot actions, increasingly pooled across embodiments [ 54 , 55 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 56 , 57 , 58 , 4 ] . World-action models (WAMs) additionally predict future observations alongside actions, using video as a dense representation of how the world evolves [ 18 , 59 , 60 ] . Zero-WAM uses in-context human videos to guide unseen tasks [ 61 ] , while ObjDream uses object-level representations and future object-state prediction to improve generalization to new layouts and backgrounds [ 62 ] . Some recover a hierarchy inside the model through embodied chain-of-thought or a high-level policy [ 63 , 64 , 65 , 66 ] . Several studies show that these policies keep the intent of an instruction but fail to execute it on new tasks, held-out perturbations or new skill combinations [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 67 ] . Recent diagnoses also find that current VLAs struggle with instructions specifying how to carry out a task [ 22 ] . One reason is that compositional coverage in action data is expensive to collect [ 68 ] . Benchmarks now measure compositional generalization directly, from compositional RL suites [ 69 ] to arm-wise composition in dual-arm VLAs [ 70 ] , alongside standard manipulation benchmarks [ 71 ] and real-to-sim evaluation [ 72 ] . ZAP learns no reasoning from action data; it learns only motion, and only in simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端策略及其组合性局限。 具身多模态语言模型[ 53 ]和视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）将推理与运动折叠进一个在机器人动作上训练的网络中，并且越来越多地在不同具身形态之间汇集数据[ 54 , 55 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 56 , 57 , 58 , 4 ]。 世界-动作模型（WAM）还在预测动作之外预测未来观测，将视频用作世界如何演化的密集表示[ 18 , 59 , 60 ]。 Zero-WAM 利用上下文内的人类视频来引导未见过的任务[ 61 ]，而 ObjDream 使用对象级表示和未来对象状态预测来提升对新布局和新背景的泛化能力[ 62 ]。 一些工作通过具身思维链或高层策略在模型内部恢复出层级结构[ 63 , 64 , 65 , 66 ]。 多项研究表明，这些策略虽然保留了指令的意图，却无法在新任务、留出扰动或新技能组合上执行该指令[ 19 , 20 , 21 , 67 ]。 近期的诊断还发现，当前的 VLA 难以应对指定如何执行任务的指令[ 22 ]。 一个原因在于，动作数据中的组合性覆盖收集起来代价高昂[ 68 ]。 基准测试现在直接度量组合性泛化，从组合性强化学习套件[ 69 ]到双臂 VLA 中按手臂进行的组合[ 70 ]，此外还有标准操作基准[ 71 ]和真实到仿真（real-to-sim）的评估[ 72 ]。 ZAP 不从动作数据中学习推理；它只学习运动，并且只在仿真中学习。

paragraphs.en: Foundation models as robot agents. Code as Policies and its successors compose perception and control APIs into programs or value maps [ 5 , 23 , 73 ] , in the style of tool-using agents [ 74 ] . RAX compiles a coding agent’s online exploration into robot programs that run without the agent [ 75 ] ; MoCaP uses passive human videos to guide code-as-policy for mobile manipulation [ 76 ] . Multimodal language-model agents remain weak at low-level manipulation when used off the shelf [ 77 ] . Recent work nonetheless uses frontier agents directly as closed-loop policies: on real YAM arms [ 7 , 8 , 32 ] , including head-to-head comparisons with VLAs on bimanual tasks [ 78 ] and in simulation [ 79 ] , through general agent frameworks [ 80 , 81 ] , through a visual interface [ 82 ] , through in-context learning [ 83 ] , through primitive motion commands [ 84 ] , or with perception tools and test-time simulation [ 9 , 85 , 86 ] . SEAR compares code-as-policy, agent-as-policy and VLA auto-research, with controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts and larger budgets [ 87 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型作为机器人智能体。 Code as Policies 及其后续工作以使用工具的智能体[74]的风格，将感知与控制 API 组合成程序或价值图[5, 23, 73]。 RAX 将编码智能体的在线探索编译成无需该智能体即可运行的机器人程序[75]；MoCaP 利用被动的人类视频来指导用于移动操作的政策即代码[76]。 多模态语言模型智能体在开箱即用时，在低层操作方面仍然表现薄弱[77]。 尽管如此，近期的工作仍直接将前沿智能体用作闭环策略：在真实的 YAM 机械臂上[7, 8, 32]，包括与 VLA 在双臂任务上的正面比较[78]以及在仿真中的比较[79]，通过通用智能体框架[80, 81]、通过视觉接口[82]、通过上下文学习[83]、通过基本运动指令[84]，或借助感知工具和测试时仿真[9, 85, 86]。 SEAR 比较了政策即代码、智能体即策略与 VLA 自动研究，其对照组将保留的经验与重复尝试以及更大的预算区分开来[87]。

paragraphs.en: Other work improves the harness, with evolving code, skill libraries or playbooks [ 88 , 89 , 90 , 91 , 92 , 93 ] . URAI lets frontier agents write, call and evolve reusable robot tools [ 94 ] , while ChunkAct chains primitives into action chunks to reduce model calls [ 95 ] . Some harnesses surround a VLA: Cracking Mobile Manipulation adds planning, navigation and local-motion interventions around a fixed policy [ 96 ] , and CarryOn adds planning and execution loops with reusable recovery skills [ 97 ] . AdaRSI first improves the harness, then fine-tunes the executor on sub-steps that remain unreliable [ 98 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 其他工作通过不断演化的代码、技能库或操作手册来改进智能体框架 [ 88 , 89 , 90 , 91 , 92 , 93 ] 。 URAI 让前沿智能体编写、调用并演化可复用的机器人工具 [ 94 ] ，而 ChunkAct 将原语串联成动作块以减少模型调用次数 [ 95 ] 。 一些框架围绕 VLA 构建：Cracking Mobile Manipulation 在固定策略之上增加了规划、导航与局部运动干预 [ 96 ] ，CarryOn 则增加了规划与执行循环以及可复用的恢复技能 [ 97 ] 。 AdaRSI 首先改进智能体框架，然后针对仍然不可靠的子步骤对执行器进行微调 [ 98 ] 。

paragraphs.en: VLMs that directly predict actions. EASG projects a tool-center-point action frame into the wrist-camera image and lets a pretrained VLM generate continuous translations and rotations as text [ 103 ] . This grounds the action space for zero-shot manipulation, and the same interface supports fine-tuning on robot trajectories. ZAP also uses the model’s native text generation to command motion, learning full absolute end-effector poses through SFT and RL entirely in simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 直接预测动作的视觉语言模型。 EASG 将工具中心点动作坐标系投影到腕部相机图像中，并让预训练的视觉语言模型以文本形式生成连续的平移和旋转 [ 103 ]。 这种方法将动作空间与视觉语言模型对接，实现了零样本操作，且同一接口还支持在机器人轨迹上进行微调。 ZAP 同样利用模型原生的文本生成来指挥运动，完全在仿真中通过监督微调和强化学习学习完整的绝对末端执行器位姿。

paragraphs.en: RL for language-model agents and embodied reasoning. Online RL can ground language models as policies in text and simulated environments [ 107 , 108 , 109 ] . Multi-turn agent RL has since scaled with GRPO-style objectives [ 36 , 110 , 111 , 112 , 113 ] .
